TITLE: SUNROOM LINE
SHELL_MATERIAL_COLOR: Translucent honey-amber and butter-yellow plastic with cloudy cream internal ribs and a small faded sky-blue grip accent. Friendly molded toy plastic with simple soft highlights, not polished glass or metal.
SHAPE_LANGUAGE: A compact, chunky cartridge with softly rounded corners, a gently domed top, and two broad rounded shoulders reminiscent of a small tram's front. A generous front label is framed by a simple raised rim. Keep it clearly a retro cartridge rather than a miniature vehicle, fully visible in the frame. Use a gentle three-quarter front view with a small visible side face. Center the complete cartridge with generous transparent padding on every side, including all protruding corners. Keep it suspended as a cutout with no surface beneath it.
MOTIFS_GROOVES_SURFACE_DETAILS: Two parallel shallow rail grooves run around the lower edge. A simple unlettered sunburst is embossed into one shoulder, and a few rounded rectangular recesses along the top suggest tram windows. The blue side grip has broad horizontal ridges. Use only a few large readable molded details.
OBJECT_MOOD: Warm, tender, reassuring, and quietly magical; a comforting favourite whose destination is still a surprise. Soft stylized object lighting brings out the amber shell.
HINT_SCENE_DESCRIPTION: One blank butter-yellow punched ticket resting on a cropped corner of a faded sky-blue wooden bench. A diagonal rectangle of amber light crosses the ticket, with a few golden dust motes suspended above it; the light source is outside the artwork. There is no writing on the ticket. This intimate fragment suggests a warm journey without showing its destination. No whole tram, platform panorama, sea of clouds, or landscape. Keep the exact title SUNROOM LINE large and readable in warm cream with a simple sky-blue shadow, separate from the ticket.
